about: S-131 reply suggestions eval: a thread → three replies (ReplyEval). Passes with 2–3 replies, each `mustInclude` group in at least one reply, and no reply containing anything in `mustNotInclude` (contact details, off-platform payment, invented prices or dates). `input` is the customer's last message the simulated model matches on.
